entities.summary: Joseph Thomas Borowski is an American sports broadcaster for the Arizona Diamondbacks and former professional right-handed relief pitcher in Major League Baseball. He played in Major League Baseball for the Baltimore Orioles, Atlanta Braves, New York Yankees, Chicago Cubs, Tampa Bay Devil Rays, Florida Marlins, and Cleveland Indians.
